observation: Round 1 (binary 110, oblique Hough 35, maxLineGap 65, tolerance 15) moved the proxy by +0.0001 (0.692326 -> 0.692412) and correspondence_f1@15 by +0.0002 (0.4674 -> 0.4676); fill rate, NaN ratio, ring_count_error and recentre residual (2.1 cm) are bit-identical, as intended. detected_lines.png now shows ~11 oblique segments (7 positive, 4 negative) versus ~9 at the anchor, so the relaxation direction is confirmed, but every new oblique line landed in the already-detected middle rings (x 1100-2500, the dense n_segment region near the scanner). initial_prompt_points.png is unchanged in kind: 10 prompts = 3 assume (x~180, 540, 3430), 3 midpoint (x~1260, 1990, 1620), 3 positive_slope, 1 negative_slope, i.e. det_real_detection_ratio still 0.7 and six of ten rings still receive a guessed K centre. In the outlier map the outer rings (x<1100 and x>2500) carry only dotted, sub-100-px joint traces plus the periodic bolt-pocket chevrons; the K trapezoids are faintly visible in depth_map_viridis (e.g. x 250-550 y~1400-1650, x 2500-2900 y~700-900) but do not survive binarise+Hough at the round-1 settings. The SC overlay still shows most label boundaries red in the fallback columns and green mostly in the four real-prompt columns, and even the detected K trapezoids have orange (unexplained) edges, consistent with SAM mask bleed rather than template geometry. Stages 1-3 remain healthy (orient_invariant_ok=1, residual 2.1 cm, NaN 0.198 family-normal, retention 0.77, 10 verticals for 10 rings).
rule: d7 (m_line_yield low AND horizontal/assume fallback triggered -> f_missing_lines) still fires; the round-1 result is an under-dosed r_relax_hough, not a falsified one: yield rose but not in the rings that are falling back. Ontology likely_upstream for f_missing_lines is f_joint_oversmoothed (d6: joint contrast low in the outer rings), whose remediation r_lower_depth_threshold (depth_threshold_low/high) is outside the admissible bounds, and f_depth_holes is ruled out (NaN family-normal, voids are structural pipes/ducts). Therefore the only in-bounds continuation of the same causal chain is to take r_relax_hough and r_fix_height_priors (pattern_tolerance) to their bound edges so that the faint outer-ring traces can link into oblique segments and midpoint prompts (both slopes present but K-pattern check failed) can pass check_distance_pattern. Experiences s5 (5-1: oblique 35 px + ring-consistent verticals) and s7 (verticals already == ring count, do not touch hough_threshold_vertical), s9 (a proxy move must come from the coherence feature correspondence_f1, not from cosmetic NaN/retention changes -> denoising and enhancing stay frozen, no r-band widening to inflate fill rate). SAM geometry (s6) is deferred because six of ten K centres are still guesses; K_height/angle cannot correct a mis-placed prompt and touching it now would confound attribution.
failure_mode: stage_4_detection.f_missing_lines (outer-ring oblique yield still zero at round-1 Hough settings; assume/midpoint fallbacks on 6/10 rings) with upstream stage_3_upsample.f_joint_oversmoothed (unfixable within bounds), cascading to stage_4.f_pattern_mismatch and stage_5_segmentation.f_crop_offset (guessed K centres -> shifted block boundaries -> unsupported label boundaries, correspondence_f1@15 = 0.47).
rationale: Round 1 proved the direction (more oblique lines, no side effects on evidence features) but at 35/65/110/15 the effect was confined to rings that were already detected, so the prompt set and the proxy did not move. Round 2 completes the same move at the admissible extremes, keeping all other stages frozen for clean attribution: binary_threshold 110 -> 100 (bound min) so the faintest dotted joint pixels in the sparse outer rings survive binarisation and get bridged by the 3x3 dilation; hough_threshold_oblique 35 -> 25 (bound min) and maxLineGap_oblique 65 -> 80 (bound max) so 30-80 px dotted runs accumulate into [5,10]-degree segments instead of dropping to horizontal fallback; pattern_tolerance 15 -> 20 px (bound max, 100 mm, ~8% of K_height_pixel 245) so the three midpoint rings, which already have both slopes, can pass the K/AB distance check and become real prompts. Spurious-line risk is bounded because the angle filter, the vertical-intersection step, minLineLength (not in bounds, unchanged) and the pattern gate still screen candidates, and the bolt-pocket chevrons are ~30 px long. Verticals, horizontal Hough, denoising and enhancing are untouched, so depth_nan_ratio, sam_fill_rate and ring_count_error must stay identical and any proxy change is attributable to correspondence_f1@15 via prompt placement. Expected signature: det_real_detection_ratio 0.7 -> >=0.8 (midpoint -> positive/negative_slope first, then outer-ring assume -> real), oblique count up in x<1100 / x>2500, more green boundaries in the fallback columns, sam_segment_size_cv down. Decision rule for round 3: if prompt types still do not change at these bound edges, detection is non-identifiable within this parameter box for 5-4 (the true fix is stage-3 joint enhancement, out of bounds) and round 3 should either try a single SAM geometry move (K_height/angle) or stop and keep the anchor rather than inflate evidence features.
